stem:
Lalit pours $5$ tenths of a litre of oil into a bottle marked in tenths and hundredths.

Which statement describes the same amount of oil?

options.text: $5$ tenths of a litre is the same as $5$ hundredths of a litre.
$5$ tenths of a litre is the same as $50$ hundredths of a litre.
$5$ tenths of a litre is the same as $5$ thousandths of a litre.
$5$ tenths of a litre is the same as the printed $5$ on the bottle cap.

teacher.key_rationale: Ten hundredths make one tenth, so 5 tenths regroup as 50 hundredths. Naming it 5 hundredths swaps the place-value part; 5 thousandths skips regrouping by tens; the bottle-cap print is a surface grab.
